Make an admin a member, who uses the organization's projects but no longer manages its team or
settings. Asks first; --yes skips that. Making someone an admin is done in the Voidhash dashboard.

Usage:
  voidhash member role [member] [role] [flags]

Arguments:
  member  The member's email, name or id
  role    member: makes an admin a member. (admin is refused: that is done in the Voidhash
          dashboard)

Flags:
  -h, --help       Show help for this command
      --json       Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --org <org>  Organization to act on: its slug, name or id (default: the organization of this
                   directory's or your default project)
  -q, --quiet      Print only ids, one per line
  -y, --yes        Make the change without asking for confirmation

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash member role ali@example.com member
  voidhash member role ali@example.com member --yes
